prompt: Kitchen tickets can carry a short handwritten note, and the expo screen calls shouldRushTicket(note, expoLean) in src/ticket-rush.mjs to decide whether a ticket jumps ahead in the queue. Cooks report that tickets noted "asap" or "fire" sit in normal rotation instead of jumping ahead; right now only the literal note "rush" gets a ticket rushed. Fix shouldRushTicket in src/ticket-rush.mjs so the recognized rush notes jump the queue. Run `npm test` to see the regression fail before your change and pass after it.
